ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast bimodal distribution with approximately 65% low-intensity (black) and 35% high-intensity (white) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central region consists of a contiguous low-intensity black mass extending from the peduncle. High-intensity white mottling and solid blocks are localized to the distal 30% of each fluke lobe. Isolated white focal spots are scattered within the black central region.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 75 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serrations (peaks ranging from 5 to 15 pixels) along the entire trailing edge boundary, isolated from the background water.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave sweep trajectory along the trailing edges from the median notch extending to the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of circular high-contrast white pixel groups (5-12 pixel diameter) concentrated at the distal tips and along the leading edges of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Two prominent unaligned linear high-intensity disruptions; one long horizontal line across the right lobe and one diagonal line across the left lobe, breaking the natural pigmentation pattern.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive irregular serration and non-uniform tissue loss along the trailing edge boundary. A prominent horizontal linear scar is visible on the mid-section of the right lobe.
